user.description: Needs an OpenWeatherMap API key with a "One Call API 4.0" subscription (the first 1,000 calls a day are free; this integration uses about 600). Set the daily limit on your OpenWeatherMap billing page to 1,000 so you are never charged.

init.description: An hour of the hourly forecast counts as rain for **Next rain** and **Rain later today** when either its chance of rain or its amount reaches the value below. Within the next hour the minute-by-minute forecast decides.
